title: JSON::XS versions from 3.04 before 4.05 for Perl write one byte past a heap buffer when appending a… (CVE-2026-129114)
description: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in JSON::XS for Perl versions from 3.04 before 4.05. The flaw occurs during incremental parsing (incr_parse) when appending a one-byte chunk, causing a one-byte write past the allocated heap buffer due to improper buffer size management.
